data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, totalled GBP 391.0 million during the calendar year (2016: GBP 448.0 million). This includes an amount of GBP 63.6 million in respect of reserve releases on 2015 and prior underwriting years (2016: GBP 33.1 million in respect of reserve releases from 2014 and prior underwriting years).

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross reserve release of GBP 63.6 million for 2015 and prior underwriting years. This favorable development was primarily influenced by the financial impact of a reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transaction with Enstar's Starstone Syndicate 2008 for all 2015 and prior business, which was reflected in the 2017 year-end reserves and involved no margin being held for these years. The 2017 calendar year also saw adverse impacts on financial results from an active Atlantic hurricane season, Mexico earthquakes, and California wildfires, though these are not explicitly linked to the prior year reserve movement.

No margin was held for 2015 and prior reserves due to the agreed value of the RITC with Enstar.
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of -63.6m is taken from a direct statement in Note 6. This differs from the calculation derived from the gross claims development triangle (-71.4m). The RITC for 2015 and prior business, effective 1 Jan 2018 but with financial impact reflected in 2017 reserves, likely influences these figures and makes the triangle less reliable for direct PYD calculation.
